# doXmind documentation index

> doXmind is a fully local, Markdown-native knowledge workspace. Markdown Pages are the only editable content type. PDF, spreadsheet, and HTML files are read-only Attachments. No account is required, and doXmind does not provide cloud document storage, telemetry, or a built-in AI runtime.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://docs.doxmind.com/introduction): Product boundary, privacy, Pages, Attachments, and legacy recovery.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.doxmind.com/quickstart): Install the Apple silicon app and create a local Page.
